description: Formal stage verification by the IterxAI desktop (verify_iterx_project — same checks, receipts and repeated-failure rules as the desktop AI): target firmware (consistency + real compile), simulation (compile + interactive simulation against the requirement), board (consistency + DRC), connection, selection, requirements, prototype, procurement, pin-consistency, assembly. ok = passed; error PROJECT_VERIFICATION_FAILED/BLOCKED/PARTIAL/UNVERIFIABLE (exit 4) carries the full receipt in data.report — unverifiable is neither pass nor failure: report it honestly. Runs headless: the desktop app when it is open (bridge project.verify), otherwise the IterxAI runtime (installed/started on demand); assembly needs a desktop window (headless it is PROJECT_VERIFICATION_BLOCKED and the consistency check in data.report.checks[] has reasonCode ASSEMBLY_WINDOW_REQUIRED). A simulation verification can take minutes: pass a progressToken to receive per-check progress; on timeout the host cancels it (VERIFY_TIMEOUT).

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

requireSimulationChange.description: simulation only: omit/true = behaviour verification; false = run-only (at most partial).

target.description: Verification target, e.g. firmware, simulation, board.

timeout.description: Wait limit, e.g. "20m" (default 21m: the host allows one verification 20 minutes). When it runs out the verification is cancelled on the host and VERIFY_TIMEOUT is returned.

name: verify_project
